whyBookWithUs.title: Local knowledge
whyBookWithUs.text: We live and work in the area, so ask us anything — the best walks, pubs, beaches and rainy-day plans.

whyBookWithUs.title: Property
whyBookWithUs.text: A single hand-picked property, prepared to the same high standard for every arrival.

whyBookWithUs.title: Quality checked
whyBookWithUs.text: Checked and cleaned before every stay, so everything works the way it should when you walk in.

whyBookWithUs.title: Customer Satisfaction
whyBookWithUs.text: Most of our guests come back or send friends. If anything falls short during your stay, tell us and we will make it right.

whyBookWithUs.title: 24/7 support
whyBookWithUs.text: A real person is on call around the clock during your stay — call any time, day or night.
